texts.here: A deafening blast throws you against the wall. Smoke and splinters fill the air, and your ears ring.
texts.near: A loud bang from the direction of {room}; the ground shudders under your feet and dust trickles from above.
texts.far: A distant boom rolls across the village, followed by shouting.

roomEffect.text: Smoke still hangs in the air; the shutters are blown out, the furniture lies in splinters and black soot streaks the walls.

effects.text: covered in soot and plaster dust, ears ringing

texts.here: Flames are licking up the wall right next to you. The heat is fierce and thick smoke stings your eyes.
texts.near: You smell smoke, and someone is shouting "Fire!" from the direction of {room}.
texts.far: A column of grey smoke rises somewhere over the village.

roomEffect.text: Part of the place is scorched black; the air stinks of burnt wood and wet ash.

texts.here: Someone right here lets out a piercing scream that cuts off suddenly.
texts.near: A piercing scream comes from the direction of {room}, then silence.
texts.far: Faintly, from somewhere in the village, you think you hear a scream.

texts.here: A bell rings three times, loud and close.
texts.near: A bell rings three times from the direction of {room}.
texts.far: Somewhere a bell rings three times.

texts.here: The sky opens: heavy rain hammers down on the roofs and turns the paths to mud.
texts.near: Heavy rain starts drumming on the roofs; the paths are turning to mud.
texts.far: Heavy rain starts drumming on the roofs; the paths are turning to mud.

roomEffect.text: Everything is soaked from the downpour; puddles and mud everywhere.

texts.here: A stranger in a torn, mud-caked cloak staggers in and collapses face down right in front of you. He isn't moving.
texts.near: Raised voices from {room}: someone shouts that a stranger has collapsed.
texts.far: You hear a commotion somewhere in the village.

roomEffect.text: A stranger in a torn, mud-caked cloak lies on the ground, breathing shallowly.

texts.here: With a roar, a slope of loose stone slides down and buries the path out of here.
texts.near: A rumble and a crash of falling stone from the direction of {room}.
texts.far: A low rumble rolls across the village.

roomEffect.text: A heap of fallen stone and earth blocks one of the paths.

texts.here: A pan flares up and the kitchen fills with flame and black smoke!
texts.near: Shouts of "Fire in the kitchen!" from {room}.
texts.far: You smell burning somewhere in the village.

roomEffect.text: The kitchen is blackened and wet from the buckets of water; nothing is being cooked.

texts.here: A cart driver hands out fresh loaves to everyone here, free of charge, and rattles on.
